tool_input.description: Get current branch and commits ahead of stage

tool_input.command:
gh pr create \
  --title "chore(web-components): add JSDoc to debounce utility" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Added JSDoc comment to the `debounce` function in `web-components/src/utils.js`
- Documents `@param {Function} func`, `@param {number} delay`, and `@returns {Function}`
- No functional changes to the implementation

## Issue
Closes #1

## Test plan
- [x] `node --check web-components/src/utils.js` passes
- [ ] JSDoc style matches existing utilities (e.g., `createTag`)
EOF
)" \
  --base stage
tool_input.description: Create pull request targeting stage branch
